def sum_of_f(S):
    N = len(S)
    x_coords = sorted(x for x, y in S)
    y_coords = sorted(y for _, y in S)
    
    prefix_sum_x = [0] * (N + 1)
    prefix_sum_y = [0] * (N + 1)
    
    for i in range(N):
        prefix_sum_x[i + 1] = (prefix_sum_x[i] + x_coords[i]) % MOD
        prefix_sum_y[i + 1] = (prefix_sum_y[i] + y_coords[i]) % MOD
    
    total_sum = 0
    for mask in range(1, 1 << N):
        count = bin(mask).count('1')
        start_x = x_coords[mask & -mask].index(True)
        end_x = x_coords[(mask & -mask)].index(False)
        start_y = y_coords[mask & -mask].index(True)
        end_y = y_coords[(mask & -mask)].index(False)
        
        area = ((end_x - start_x + 1) * (end_y - start_y + 1)) % MOD
        total_sum = (total_sum + count * area) % MOD
    
    return total_sum

def count_subsets(N, points):
    points.sort()
    xs, ys = zip(*points)
    left = [0] * N
    right = [N] * N
    stack_x = []
    stack_y = []
    
    for i, x in enumerate(xs):
        while stack_x and x < xs[stack_x[-1]]:
            right[stack_x.pop()] = i
        if stack_x:
            left[i] = stack_x[-1]
        stack_x.append(i)
    
    for i, y in enumerate(ys):
        while stack_y and y < ys[stack_y[-1]]:
            right[stack_y.pop()] = i
        if stack_y:
            left[i] = stack_y[-1]
        stack_y.append(i)
    
    result = 0
    for i in range(N):
        result += (i - left[i]) * (right[i] - i)
    
    return result % MOD

MOD = 998244353

def solve(N, points):
    x_sorted = sorted(points, key=lambda p: p[0])
    y_sorted = sorted(points, key=lambda p: p[1])

    def count_subsets(prefix_sums, suffix_sums):
        total = 0
        for i in range(len(points)):
            prefix = prefix_sums[i]
            suffix = len(points) - i - 1 - suffix_sums[i]
            total += (prefix + suffix) * (1 << i)
            total %= MOD
        return total

    prefix_x = [bisect.bisect_right(x_sorted, (points[i][0], float('inf'))) for i in range(N)]
    suffix_x = [N - bisect.bisect_left(x_sorted, (points[i][0], float('-inf')))) for i in range(N)]
    prefix_y = [bisect.bisect_right(y_sorted, (float('inf'), points[i][1])) for i in range(N)]
    suffix_y = [N - bisect.bisect_left(y_sorted, (float('-inf'), points[i][1])) for i in range(N)]

    total_x = count_subsets(prefix_x, suffix_x)
    total_y = count_subsets(prefix_y, suffix_y)

    result = (total_x * total_y) % MOD
    return result
